item.title: Re: The 7th Panzer Division - seeking greenlight
item.content:encoded:
I think it has potential. It would make me really curious if something went wrong summoning the ghosts, instead of them deserting.

Expecially if you don't know what make the ghosts that you have total control go against you, or you could just mention a vague disaster, to make it more mysterious and omnous.

Hope you get the greenlight! Have a great day! :D

item.title: The 7th Panzer Division - seeking greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): History probably

Elevator Pitch: A group of ex-nazis with a Panzer III are given the ability to spawn an entire division of ghost tanks with an anomalous radio, given to them by the Obskuracorps.

Central Narrative: They go into hiding after abandoning the nazi cause and uses their anomalous capability, guns, utilities, etc, to survive in the wilderness and avoid capture. They manage to survive when one of the crew member abandon's the remaining tank crew and surrender himself to an undercover SCP agent.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Compared to most ghost stories on this site, this one features the ability to spawn ghosts and actually have control over them

Additional Notes: I'm aware that this idea was already brought up but I thought I wanted to try and improve on the idea and sand it out a bit: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/t-1818585/ghost-division-ghost-blitzkrieg

I also want to try and incorporate some historical figures and tales into this such as Erwin Rommel being the leader of this group of deserter, and the tale of Hiroo Onoda the Japanese soldier who didn't surrender for 29 years after WWII.

Hiroo Onoda: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0XI3sJlk8yo
